# Support

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| **A wrong fact check** (*hibás tényellenőrzés*), in Hungarian or English | the flag on the fact's card, or the [Tényellenőrzés helyesbítése](https://github.com/kenyerman/vitaradar.hu/issues/new?template=fact-correction.yml) form |
| **Something broken**, in English | [bug report](https://github.com/kenyerman/vitaradar.hu/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) |
| **An idea**, in English | [suggestion](https://github.com/kenyerman/vitaradar.hu/issues/new?template=suggestion.yml) |
| **Questions, your account, private matters** | help@vitaradar.hu |
| **A security problem** | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not a public issue |
| **Support the project** | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/vitaradar_hu) |

English is this repository's language; only fact-check reports are accepted in Hungarian. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

How the site works, what the verdicts mean and what it stores: the
[impresszum](https://vitaradar.hu/impresszum.html) (in Hungarian).
